body.name: Complete rank-one alternating-factor calibration array
body.construction: Along \(n\in8\mathbb N\), set \(N=T=n\), \(I=J=\{1,\ldots,n\}\), \(G=\{1,\ldots,n/4\}\), \(S=\{1,\ldots,n/2\}\), \(W=\{n/2+2,\ldots,3n/4+1\}\), and \(C(t)=I\setminus G\). Hence \((N/n,T/n,m/n,g/n,H/n)=(1,1,1/2,1/4,1/4)\). For each target use \(I_{it}=C(t)\cup\{i\}\), \(J_{it}=S\cup\{t\}\), the increasing orderings, and \(R_{it}\); every target is at least two calendar periods after \(S\), and \(\Omega_{\mathrm{loc}}^{it}=\Omega\cap(I_{it}\times J_{it})=C(t)\times(S\cup\{t\})\;\cup\;\{i\}\times S\), with sole missing local coordinate \((i,t)\). Set \(r=q=1\), \(c_{\mathrm{loc}}=1/2<\sqrt{3/8}\), \(U_{i1}=u^{\mathrm{cal}}_i=n^{-1/2}\), \(p_t=p^{\mathrm{alt}}_t=1+\tfrac12(-1)^t\), \(V_{t1}=v^{\mathrm{cal}}_t=p_t/\sqrt{5n/4}\), \(\psi=n^{4/5}\), \(D=(\psi)\), \(M=UDV^{\top}\), \(\epsilon_{it}=z_{it}+\tfrac12z_{i,t-1}\) for independent \(z_{it}\sim N(0,1)\), and \(\lambda_n=4\sqrt n\,\log(n+2)\). The induced covariance is \(\gamma(0)=5/4\), \(\gamma(1)=1/2\), and \(\gamma(h)=0\) for \(|h|>1\). For \(t\in W\), \(\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}=\sigma_1(R_{it}M)=\psi\sqrt{(3/4+1/n)\{1/2+4p_t^2/(5n)\}}\), so \(\inf_{i,t}\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}/\psi>c_{\mathrm{loc}}\) for all sufficiently large \(n\), and \(\kappa^{\mathrm{drift}}_t=-2\gamma(1)p_t(n/m)(1-\rho_{\mathrm{alt}}^2)/(1+\rho_{\mathrm{alt}}^2)^{3/2}=-12p_t/(5\sqrt5)\).
